pages.title: Trust Through the Ages
pages.text: Learn a real exotic-animal bond instead of clicking every species in a catalogue.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Vallumraptor takes Serene Salad after stealing a Dinosaur Nugget and relaxing; Raycat takes Radgill, Leptictidium takes a Pouch of Seeds and Neogene Pebas Gnatusuchus takes Raw Fillet. Follow the chosen species’ native procedure. Credit requires the creature to actually become yours. Relicheirus

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: soup logging is a separate service, not taming.

pages.title: Field notes
pages.text: Vallumraptor first steals a Dinosaur Nugget from a chest. Wait for relaxation then offer Serene Salad; nuggets breed it and stealth supports its recovery.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Correction: Pebas Gnatusuchus takes Raw Fillet. Clams belong to the Carbonemys route in Cerrejon.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Prepare and eat one specialty: Deep Sea Sushi, Vesper Stew or Mosquito Repellent Stew. Combine deep fish into sushi, cook Vesper Wings into stew or use Triops eggs for mosquito-repellent stew. Toss carrots to both Triops parents; eggs can also hatch. One chosen dish is enough.
